metadata.description: Official website of the Scientific Committee at Palestine Technical University – Kadoorie, Al-Aroub branch, serving students with resources, workshops, events, and academic materials.

hero.kicker: Palestine Technical University – Kadoorie · Al-Aroub Branch
hero.subtitle: The Scientific Committee is a student-led community that turns academic knowledge into practical skills — through summaries, opportunities, and open discussion.

pillars.title: Our pillars, one community
pillars.subtitle: Everything we do is designed to make learning clearer, more practical, and more collaborative for PTUK students.

items.title: Educational summaries
items.description: Clear, student-made summaries of course material that make revision faster and understanding deeper.

items.title: Community & discussion
items.description: A space for students to ask, explain, and share knowledge across the campus.

community.title: Academic & technical discussions
community.subtitle: We keep the conversation going between lectures — on campus and online. Ask a question, explain a topic, or find a study partner.
community.note: Discussion groups are hosted by the committee

join.title: Want to be part of the committee?
join.description: We are always looking for curious, motivated students. No experience required — just willingness to learn and share.

about.title: The Scientific Committee
about.subtitle: Who we are, what we believe in, and the people behind the work.
about.mission: To make technical and academic knowledge accessible, practical, and collaborative for every student at the university.
about.membersSubtitle: A rotating team of student volunteers from across our majors.

activities.title: Study Sessions
activities.description: Sessions led by committee members to help students solve their problems.

activities.title: Tech competitions
activities.description: We help teams form, prepare, and compete in local and national challenges.

activities.title: Career panels
activities.description: Lectures and meetups by companies at the university branch.
